reader_sentence: Across GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M and Gemma-2-2B, integrated gradients matches head-ablation effects most closely (mean Spearman ρ ≈ 0.84), followed by attribution patching (0.62), gradient×input (0.45), saliency (0.29) and activation magnitude (0.18), and this ranking holds for all three models.
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
